tail:
Authored two A-page definitions and three B-page examples/counterexamples, then updated the assigned pages, manifest, contracts, coverage, source records, and batch notes. The definitions use cohomological grading and separate left/right module signs, consistent with [Stacks Project §22.3](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/061V), [§22.11](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0FPZ), and [Keller §3.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/9910179v2).

The scoped checks passed: precheck (3 proof items), proof layout (5 items, 10 steps), proof contracts (3/3), content policy (5 items), renderer (7 files), focused dependency checks, and source fetch (2/2). Batch-local dependency levels are 0, 1, 1, 1, and 2.

**Readiness is blocked.** `step1-decisions record` fails before writing because the run has duplicate claims for `lem-it-quantum-relative-entropy-support-regularization` in batches 21 and 22. The run-wide level check also reports 123 empty inventories, 3 duplicate IDs, and 8 level mismatches; proof-contract coverage stops at an empty inventory in another batch. I left those files and all shared state untouched. The notes also record the unresolved batch 32 interface comparison affecting the DG-module definition and its regular-module example.

See the [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/homological-algebra/dg-and-homological-algebra-foundations.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/homological-algebra/dg-and-homological-algebra-foundations-examples.md), [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-41.pages.json), and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-41.notes.md).
